_readme: All photos are WhatsApp-compressed phone shots (750-960px wide). They were colour-corrected, denoised and cropped, and faces were blurred. Never display any image wider than maxDisplayWidthCss (approx. native/1.5), or it will look soft on retina screens. Swap in original-resolution files when the client supplies them: keep the same ids so nothing else changes. The duotone versions use ink #0F2A1D -> paper #F4EFE6.

photos.notes: Only wide shot of the room. Face blurred. Use small (gallery), not as a hero.
